assumptionsMade: Mobile framework: Flutter (cross-platform game-style UI, map progression, strong Android/iOS parity)
Python backend framework: FastAPI
Hosting: low-cost provider (e.g. Railway or Render) paired with NeonDB
Crash reporting: Firebase Crashlytics
Dark mode: included (agent choice — professional neutral theme with light/dark)
Bundle ID placeholder: com.anointed.app (finalize before store submission)
Ad network: Google AdMob as default integration target (undecided by user — swappable)
Data residency: no strict regional lock; prioritize cost-effective regions compatible with NeonDB
Budget: not specified — optimize for minimal hosting and third-party costs
DAU success metric: no numeric target specified
Competitor names: not provided — differentiation via progressive challenge formats and level-by-level difficulty
Tamil translations (future): agent-generated draft content for review by church stakeholders
Users aged 13–17: grouped with youth/adult flows unless age-gated into kid mode
Challenge formats beyond standard Q&A: agent designs varied mechanics (hints, clues, image/text puzzles) increasing difficulty per level
Free tier: levels 1–5 playable without purchase; levels 6–100 require one-time IAP (~₹49 via Apple/Google stores — parent-friendly impulse tier; regional store pricing applies)
Monetization v1: IAP-primary for kid audience — under-13 users see no interstitial ads (negligible COPPA CPM + UX/store-review risk); ad-supported free tier for users 13+ only, capped frequency
Practice mode: offline-capable subset of gameplay without ads, leaderboard, or IAP prompts
Main/ranked mode: requires internet for ads, leaderboard sync, and IAP
Leaderboard refresh: polled every few minutes (not realtime websocket)
v1 auth simplified to phone number OR Google Sign-In OR Sign in with Apple only — no biometric login, no SMS OTP, no email/password
Phone sign-up collects mobile + name + age without SMS verification (low friction; account portability on new device relies on Google/Apple sign-in or support)
Sign in with Apple included in v1 alongside Google Sign-In (App Store requirement when Google is offered)
v1 launch question types: text_qa and verse_clue; image_clue schema/UI supported but not launch-blocking unless image assets are ready — see design-spec §18H
Admin dashboard v1: AdminJS embedded in FastAPI (not custom React); Retool acceptable alternative — see design-spec §23
Local notification reminders in v1 (on-device only); remote FCM/APNs push deferred post-v1 — see design-spec §22
Leaderboard anti-cheat: server-authoritative LevelAttempt with per-answer validation; no client-submitted scores — see design-spec §21
Phone-path abuse control: no SMS OTP in v1, but account creation is rate-limited by IP + app install ID; leaderboard attempts also rate-limited
Flutter localization infrastructure (ARB/l10n) included from day one even though launch language is English
notApplicable: Remote push notifications / FCM/APNs server (local on-device reminders ARE in v1 — see design-spec §22)
Deep linking / universal links (not required for v1)
Media uploads by end users (content managed via admin dashboard)
Device permissions (camera, location, contacts, microphone) — notification permission requested only after user opts in to local reminders (§22)

discovery.concept: Anointed — a Bible character guessing quiz game with a visual level map, progressive difficulty, and varied challenge formats. Players learn and recall Bible characters across 100 levels (v1), scaling toward 300+ levels covering 3,000+ named Bible characters in future versions.
discovery.audience: Church community across generations: kids (6–12, primary v1 UX focus), youth (18–24), adults, and elders. First-run experience optimized for kids 6–12 with accessibility accommodations for elders.
discovery.problem: Help users understand and remember Bible characters through engaging, level-based challenges rather than static Q&A.

product.businessModel: Free download. Monetization is IAP-primary: one-time purchase (~₹49) unlocks levels 6–100 after a 5-level free trial. Interstitial ads only for users aged 13+ in main/ranked mode, frequency-capped (under-13 ad-free — COPPA non-personalized CPM is negligible). Practice mode is always ad-free. Unit economics are intentionally ministry/low-cost: at 5% conversion, 20,000 installs ≈ 1,000 purchases ≈ ₹49,000 gross before store fees.
product.successDefinition: Daily active users (DAU) — primary 6-month success metric; no numeric target specified.
product.competitors: Many existing Bible quiz and trivia apps; differentiation is more interesting progressive challenge formats (not a plain Q&A wizard), level-by-level difficulty increase, and a map-based progression experience.
product.outOfScope: v1 targets 100 levels only (not full 300-level / 3,000+ character scope — planned for future versions). Biometric login, SMS OTP verification, and email/password auth deferred/removed for v1.
product.paymentProcessor: Apple App Store IAP and Google Play Billing for level-unlock purchase (~₹49 tier — agent selects nearest store price tier); AdMob interstitial for 13+ main mode only, frequency-capped

monetization.iapStoreTierNote: Agent selects nearest Apple/Google price tier (~₹49 INR / ~$0.99 USD equivalent)
monetization.adsUnder13: none — under-13 main mode is ad-free; IAP is primary revenue for kid segment
monetization.ads13Plus: interstitial after every 3rd level complete in main mode; max 2 per session; never on levels 1–3; practice mode always ad-free
monetization.infrastructureCostsV1: No SMS OTP in v1. Costs: hosting (Railway/Render), NeonDB, transactional email for VPC — sized for 100–500 users year 1

uxui.criticalFlows: 1) Launch → level map. 2) First-time sign-up: Welcome → Google Sign-In OR Sign in with Apple OR phone (mobile + name + age) → age gate → parental consent if under 13 → privacy/ToS → account created. 3) Returning sign-in: Google, Apple, or phone (same device session persists until sign-out). 4) Start game → select level → 10 mixed-format questions under timer → all correct to pass; wrong answer restarts level; answers not revealed; question sets vary. 5) Progress levels 1–5 (free) → IAP unlock levels 6–100. 6) Leaderboard (internet, periodic refresh). 7) Practice mode (offline). 8) Account deletion in-app. 9) Force-upgrade block.
uxui.brand: Attractive, professional, neutral church-friendly look — no existing style guide; agent to define design tokens (warm, approachable palette suitable for kids and elders).
uxui.accessibility: Screen reader support (VoiceOver/TalkBack). Larger text option for elders. High readability for quiz content.
uxui.offline: Practice mode playable offline using a versioned local Practice Content Pack. Main/ranked mode requires internet — questions fetched live from server; admin content updates apply immediately on next level attempt. Practice pack refreshes in background when online and server content_version is newer (see design-spec §19).
uxui.tabletSupport: required — tablet layouts with landscape orientation supported

localization.infrastructure: Flutter gen_l10n / ARB files required from day one; all UI strings externalized even though only English ships in v1
localization.translationOwner: agent (draft Tamil content in future release; church review recommended before publish)

backend.entities: User, ParentalConsentRecord, Level, BibleCharacter, Question, ContentPublishRecord, LevelAttempt (server-authoritative ranked attempts with per-answer validation), LeaderboardEntry (server-written only from validated attempts), UserProgress, PurchaseRecord, AdImpressionLog, AnalyticsEvent, AdminUser
backend.integrations: Apple App Store IAP, Google Play Billing, Google Sign-In, Sign in with Apple, ad network (TBD — AdMob default), transactional email provider for parent VPC links (e.g. SendGrid/Resend/SES), optional Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics

contentSync.mainModeQuestions: Server-authoritative — fetched live at level start via game API
contentSync.practiceModeQuestions: Local Practice Content Pack — offline-capable, refreshed via GET /v1/content/manifest + GET /v1/content/practice-pack when content_version is newer
contentSync.versioning: Monotonic content_version incremented on admin publish only; draft edits do not affect clients until publish
contentSync.packStrategyV1: Full gzipped pack replacement, not delta updates; expected 1–5 MB for text/verse launch pack and larger if image assets are included

contentTargets.imageClueLaunchPolicy: Not launch-blocking; text_qa + verse_clue must cover all levels. image_clue can publish post-launch as assets become ready.

backend.realtime: Not required — leaderboard and analytics use periodic polling/sync every few minutes
backend.scale: 100–500 users in first year; 100 levels × 10 questions; ~300 characters in v1 content pool

pushNotifications.localTriggers: 3-day and 7-day inactivity nudge; rescheduled on app open
pushNotifications.notes: flutter_local_notifications; opt-in after first level complete; no server push infra in v1

leaderboard.antiCheat: Server-authoritative LevelAttempt — per-answer validation, sequence integrity, time plausibility; client cannot POST scores; see design-spec §21

abusePrevention.phoneSignup: Rate-limit account creation by IP + generated app install ID; no covert device fingerprinting for children
abusePrevention.limits: Suggested v1 defaults: max 5 account creations per install per day, max 20 per IP per day, max 20 ranked attempt starts per user per hour
abusePrevention.futureHardening: Apple App Attest / Play Integrity can be added if scripted abuse appears

mediaUploads.types: N/A — quiz content managed via admin dashboard, not user uploads

backend.timezoneHandling: Store timestamps in UTC; display local time for leaderboard daily/weekly boundaries and admin reports

techStack.hosting: agent's choice — low-cost (e.g. Railway or Render for API; NeonDB managed Postgres)

security.dataCollected: Mobile number, name, age, age group, gameplay progress, level attempts, leaderboard scores, IAP purchase/receipt data, ad interaction logs (non-personalized for under-13), analytics events, parental consent record for users under 13
security.authMethod: v1 offers two paths only: (1) Google Sign-In or Sign in with Apple — OAuth token exchange, server-side account; (2) Phone — mobile number + name + age, no SMS OTP. No email/password, no biometric.
security.accountRecovery: New device: sign in again with Google or Apple (restores account automatically). Phone-only users: re-enter mobile + name on sign-in (no OTP); if account cannot be recovered, contact support via M-31. No SMS OTP in v1.

accountDeletion.notes: Apple requires in-app deletion where account creation is offered. Delete personal data and ParentalConsentRecord immediately. Retain legally required purchase/audit records only after anonymizing user linkage where possible.

methods: oauth_parent_attestation — parent signs in with own Google/Apple + attestation form (Path A, default)
email_plus_confirmation — parent email receives signed link to web confirmation page (Path B, required for phone-path under-13)
parentalConsent.notSufficient: Child self-attestation or checkbox alone without parent OAuth or email verification
parentalConsent.accountStateWhilePending: pending_parental_consent — no gameplay, no ads, no PII-linked analytics until verified

security.sessionManagement: Persistent session until explicit sign-out; no inactivity timeout

socialLogin.providers: Google Sign-In, Sign in with Apple (Apple required on iOS when Google is offered)

security.dataResidency: No strict requirement specified — agent to select cost-effective hosting; note COPPA/privacy obligations for minors
security.retentionPolicy: Immediate data removal on account deletion; no extended retention window

appStore.bundleId: undecided — agent placeholder com.anointed.app until finalized

qa.mustNotBreak: Sign-up and sign-in (Google, Apple, phone); age gate/parental consent flow; level map navigation; completing a level (10/10 correct under timer); level restart on wrong answer; timer scaling by difficulty; mixed question variant types per level; IAP unlock after level 5; ad display rules (13+ capped, under-13 none); server-validated leaderboard attempts (anti-cheat); leaderboard submit and periodic sync; offline practice mode; local notification opt-in and scheduling; in-app account deletion; force-upgrade block; admin dashboard content management and exportable reports
qa.deviceCoverage: iPhone and Android phones; iPhone and Android tablets with landscape support

support.channel: In-app FAQ plus email contact form

analytics.events: level_started, level_completed, level_failed, level_restarted, question_answered, timer_expired, ad_viewed, ad_clicked, purchase_initiated, purchase_completed, leaderboard_viewed, leaderboard_submitted, leaderboard_attempt_rejected, practice_mode_started, sign_up_started, sign_up_completed, sign_in_completed, age_gate_triggered, vpc_parent_gate_viewed, vpc_path_selected, vpc_parent_oauth_completed, vpc_attestation_submitted, vpc_email_requested, vpc_email_verified, parental_consent_completed, child_privacy_notice_acknowledged, content_manifest_checked, content_cache_updated, content_cache_update_failed, local_notification_scheduled, local_notification_opened, account_deleted, screen_view, session_start
analytics.personalization: Adaptive difficulty — adjust question difficulty and timer pressure based on user performance history within age-appropriate bounds
analytics.reporting: Internal web admin dashboard for operator with exportable reports (CSV/PDF); track DAU, level funnel, IAP conversion, ad impressions, and leaderboard engagement

constraints.budget: Not specified — minimize third-party and hosting costs
constraints.timeline: 1 week target for v1 with 100 levels built and validated by QA agent (aggressive)
